_comment: Pell exists only via map present_when:missing_recruit_started. Bare graph is intentional—no talk_pool. Repeat interaction safely re-banks found_missing_recruit idempotently.

hub.speaker: Pell
hub.text: Dead gods, an actual person. I heard scratching that wasn't rats, then I lost the ladder in the dark, and I've been down here just — you're not going to tell Ashgrave I panicked, are you?

text_variants.text: Made it back fine, thanks to you. Ashgrave's already got me on report-writing duty for it. Fair, honestly.

options.text: Let's get you back to the barracks.
